description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView, used to display log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data with levels, tags, messages, and exceptions, and chains to other LogNode instances for log forwarding.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log data, implementing LogNode for chainable logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data, then updates the UI thread to display it. Also forwards to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiters if they are not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a log string as a new line in the LogView.
